arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS race_count,
    COUNT(c.circuitId) AS matched_circuits,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.year) AS season_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN time(r.time) IS NOT NULL THEN r.year END) AS seasons_with_times,
    COUNT(r.time) AS nonnull_times,
    COUNT(time(r.time)) AS parsed_times,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr(r.time, 1, 2) < '24' THEN 1 END) AS clock_times,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL AND time(r.time) IS NULL THEN quote(r.time) END) AS unparsed_values,
    MIN(time(r.time)) AS first_clock_time,
    MAX(time(r.time)) AS last_clock_time
FROM races AS r
LEFT JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId

arguments.sql:
WITH extremes AS (
    SELECT MIN(r.time) AS earliest_time, MAX(r.time) AS latest_time
    FROM races AS r
),
extreme_circuits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.time AS start_time, c.circuitRef AS circuit_ref
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
    WHERE r.time IN (e.earliest_time, e.latest_time)
)
SELECT
    (
        SELECT group_concat(circuit_ref, ', ')
        FROM (
            SELECT ec.circuit_ref
            FROM extreme_circuits AS ec
            WHERE ec.start_time = e.earliest_time
            ORDER BY ec.circuit_ref
        )
    ) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (
        SELECT group_concat(circuit_ref, ', ')
        FROM (
            SELECT ec.circuit_ref
            FROM extreme_circuits AS ec
            WHERE ec.start_time = e.latest_time
            ORDER BY ec.circuit_ref
        )
    ) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    CAST(strftime('%s', e.latest_time) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%s', e.earliest_time) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
FROM extremes AS e
LIMIT 1
